_doc: AI 配樂的共用設定（scripts/bgm-gen.py 與伺服器的配樂產生器共用；docs/audio-design.md 的「AI 配樂」）：BASE 共同曲風、VOICE 聲線、ARR 各類型的編曲（交戰版）、CALM 平時版、PALETTE 各章的音色、VOICE_OF／BPM_OF 各類型的預設聲線與速度。描述（編曲＋音色＋聲線＋共同曲風）最多 512 字。
BASE: Japanese anime song, J-pop royal road progression, bittersweet melancholic yet uplifting, sorrowful piano and strings fused with breakbeat groove, ethereal reverb, upfront vocal

VOICE.girl: bright clear high-pitched young female vocal, sweet airy translucent tone, innocent yet ethereal, Japanese lyrics
VOICE.diva: powerful mature female alto rock diva vocal, low husky chest voice, strong belting, passionate and confident, Japanese lyrics
VOICE.duet: female duet, a powerful husky rock diva and a bright high sweet girl trading lines, Japanese lyrics

ARR.theme: full anime opening theme song, piano intro, soaring chorus, strings, breakbeat drums and bass
ARR.battle: high-energy liquid drum and bass anime battle song, chopped amen breaks, rolling sub bass, slap bass
ARR.front: epic marching battle anthem, big war drums, choir, strings ostinato over breakbeat, heroic
ARR.elite: intense rock anime battle song, distorted electric guitar riffs, fast breakbeat drums, rival duel tension
ARR.destroy: heavy half-time anime battle track, huge bass drops, metallic percussion, explosive impacts
ARR.colossus: massive epic hybrid orchestral track, slow giant pulse, heavy bass, choir, taiko drums, colossal scale
ARR.defend: determined mid-tempo breakbeat anthem, hopeful strings, warm protective feeling, steady drums
ARR.escort: driving steady groove, road journey feeling, funky bass line, hopeful piano riff, light breakbeat
ARR.extract: urgent countdown tension, ticking hi-hats, rising synth arpeggios, desperate yet hopeful, fast drums
ARR.breakthrough: relentless fast neurofunk drum and bass, adrenaline rush, short chopped vocal hooks
ARR.chase: frantic high speed chase, racing breakbeat, funk guitar cutting, rushing synth bass, vocal hooks
ARR.intel: stealthy trip-hop, dusty slow breakbeat, mysterious rhodes piano, whispered breathy vocal, tension
ARR.supply: calm lo-fi hip-hop, warm felt piano, soft vinyl texture, gentle humming vocal, rest and nostalgia
ARR.boss: climactic boss battle anime song, hybrid orchestral electronic, choir, distorted bass, fast drum and bass
ARR.air: soaring sky battle anime song, fast uplifting trance and drum and bass, wide strings, flight and freedom

CALM: quiet ambient version, soft piano and warm pads, gentle humming vocal, sparse light percussion, no heavy drums, calm and spacious

PALETTE.1: desert wind, dusty acoustic guitar, warm analog synth, ochre sunset wasteland
PALETTE.2: industrial metallic percussion, rain, city pop electric piano, funk, rusty factory
PALETTE.3: glassy bells, icy pads, crystalline piano, frozen silence, snowfield
PALETTE.4: glitch electronics, cyber arpeggios, digital textures, vertical megastructure
PALETTE.5: oceanic liquid pads, waves, wide stereo, sea breeze, floating city
PALETTE.6: space ambient, celestial choir, weightless starlight synths, orbit
PALETTE.7: aggressive industrial, taiko drums, roaring fire, distorted synths, volcano forge
PALETTE.8: grand finale, full orchestra and choir, hope after despair, all motifs return, giant ark
